title: Paid for commissions? Set this aside
label: Artists · Tax

hook.sub: Nothing is withheld from art income.

lines: Leo paints pet portraits on commission.
Clients pay him by PayPal and Venmo.
No tax comes out of any of it.

beats.note: Once net earnings reach $400 for the year.

beats.sub: If you expect to owe $1,000 or more for 2026.

items.t: Move a set share of every commission
Pay by each IRS due date

captions.instagram:
Commission money arrives with nothing taken out for taxes, so the bill shows up later unless you plan for it.

✔️ Self-employment tax is 15.3% (Social Security and Medicare) once net earnings reach $400, on top of income tax.
✔️ Expect to owe $1,000 or more for 2026? The IRS expects estimated payments during the year. The last 2026 payment is due Jan. 15, 2027.
✔️ Open a separate savings account and move a set share of every commission the day it lands.
✔️ Pay by each Form 1040-ES due date: April, June, September and January.

Our artists page explains quarterly tax, with a calculator for your number.
